question: Which EV charging programs are open now?
html:
Three EV charging opportunities are open as of Oct 8, 2026. Two are formal bids, SRTA New Bedford (due Oct 9, 2026) and Cambridge (due Nov 10, 2026). The third is MassDOT's NEVI installer call, open to Oct 31, 2026 (CET opportunity radar).

Open EV charging opportunities

OpportunityOwnerDeadlineCET angle
New Bedford DC fast-charger (DCFC) installSRTAOct 9, 2026Bid from the Taunton office
Neighborhood EV charging (federal-aid)City of CambridgeNov 10, 2026Municipal charging bid
NEVI developers' installer callMassDOT, via Global Montello / Applegreen memoOpen to Oct 31, 2026Installer partnership reply

(CET opportunity radar)

What sits around them

  • Maine NEVI. Applegreen has 2026 Maine NEVI awards. The radar suggests offering it the same installer partnership as in Massachusetts. This is an outreach target, not an open solicitation.
  • Multi-state pipeline. Together, the MassDOT and Maine pieces could form a multi-state DCFC install pipeline (est.).
  • Bid requirements. The radar flags MassDOT prequalification and DBE requirements for these bids. Confirm them directly with each owner. This answer does not assess eligibility.

(CET opportunity radar)

What the data does not show

  • No contract values. The radar lists no dollar value for any of these EV items. Values would come from the SRTA and Cambridge bid documents and from the MassDOT developers' installer memo.
  • Snapshot date. The radar was generated Sep 24, 2026. Status after that date is not confirmed.
  • Blocked portals. Some state portals blocked automated access, including COMMBUYS, CTsource, RI Purchasing and NH DAS. EV solicitations posted only there may be missing. A manual check of those portals would close the gap.

(CET opportunity radar)

Fit with the growth plan

EV depot charging is one of the Phase 3 lines meant to turn one-off bids into recurring contracts. Two other examples are SCADA monitoring and solar and storage O&M. That service mix is priced 3 or more turns above project-heavy contractors (CET growth plan).

Every charger CET installs now is a site it could later maintain under contract. That turns project revenue into the recurring service mix the exit multiple depends on.

Next actions

  1. SRTA New Bedford. Confirm the bid is complete for Oct 9, 2026, with Taunton estimating and staffing it.
  2. MassDOT NEVI. Reply to the installer call before Oct 31, 2026. In parallel, contact Applegreen about its Maine NEVI sites.
  3. Cambridge. Pull the bid documents and confirm MassDOT prequalification and DBE requirements with the owner well before Nov 10, 2026.
  4. Portal gaps. Search COMMBUYS and the CT, RI and NH portals by hand for EV solicitations the radar could not reach.
